lines.rom: kusmanda jaya jaga sukhadani mujha para daya karo maharani pingala jvalamukhi nirali sakambari mam bholi bhali
lakhom nama nirale tere bhakta kai matavale tere bhima parvata para hai dera svikaro pranama ye mera
sabaki sunati ho jagadambe sukha pahumcati ho mam ambe tere darsana ka maim pyasa purna kara do meri asa
